name: zerorouter
description: Personal AI API gateway: connect providers, discover models, route requests through one normalized OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm -w packages/server run dev" "npm -w packages/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w packages/web run build && npm -w packages/server run build
scripts.test: npm -w packages/server run test && npm -w packages/web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w packages/server run typecheck && npm -w packages/web run typecheck
